region.description: AWS region; GovCloud (us-gov-west-1, us-gov-east-1) and commercial regions are both valid.

validation.error_message: region must be an AWS region name such as us-gov-west-1.

name_prefix.description: Prefix for resource names; target group names allow at most 32 characters in total.

validation.error_message: name_prefix must be 2-19 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens.

public_subnet_ids.description: Public subnets in at least two availability zones for the ALB.

validation.error_message: An ALB needs subnets in at least two availability zones.

ingress_cidrs.description: IPv4 ranges allowed to reach the listener on 443.

validation.error_message: ingress_cidrs must be a non-empty list of IPv4 CIDR blocks.

certificate_arn.description: ACM certificate for the dashboard host name, in this partition and region.

access_logs_bucket.description: S3 bucket receiving ALB access logs (infra/monitoring).

api_security_group_id.description: Security group of the api ECS tasks (infra/platform).

keycloak_security_group_id.description: Security group of the Keycloak ECS tasks (infra/platform).

api_port.description: TLS port the api task listens on; the ALB re-encrypts to it.

keycloak_port.description: Keycloak HTTPS port; the ALB re-encrypts to it.

keycloak_management_port.description: Keycloak management interface (health). Health-checked only; no listener rule routes to it.
